options.content:
**Are my shields online?**

These panels show if the underlying security engines are currently running and protecting you. 

* **Pi-hole IPS**: Blocks known bad domains.
* **Zeek Network Monitor**: Watches device behavior.
* **Threat Intel (TI)**: Checks IPs against global hacker databases.
* **ML FP Engine**: The AI that learns what is safe so you don't get false alarms.

panels.title: Pi-hole IPS

options.content:
**The bird's-eye view of your entire home.**

Each row is a device. The columns are different AI and heuristic checks. If a column turns **red**, that device is acting suspiciously in that specific way.

* **Threat Confidence**: Overall chance this device is infected. (High = Bad)
* **ML Outlier**: Is this device acting completely different from yesterday?
* **Kill-chain**: Has the attack progressed to data theft? 
* **Probation**: Devices recently joined to the network that the AI is still learning.

panels.title: 🛡️ What did the system block for me?

options.content:
When the AI is 100% confident, it will automatically isolate the device or sinkhole its DNS traffic. This saves you from having to manually unplug things.

Check the counters below to see how many threats were neutralized today.

panels.title: Total Active Isolations
panels.description: Number of devices/domains currently being actively blocked in real-time.

panels.title: Lifetime Threats Blocked
panels.description: Historical counter of all automated mitigations executed since installation.

panels.title: Total Alerts Triaged
panels.description: Total number of network alerts the system has processed and triaged.

options.content:
**Where is your network talking to?**

This massive map plots every external IP address your devices connect to. Dots are colored by their **Risk Score**.

A smart lightbulb shouldn't be connecting to random servers in high-risk countries. If you see bright red dots in unusual places, click on the **Device Deep Dive** dashboard to investigate.

panels.title: Network Geographic Footprint
panels.description: Shows real-time connections. Size/Color indicates threat risk.

panels.title: 🚨 Alerts Triggered Over Time
panels.description: Timeline mapping exactly when alerts spiked on the network, categorized by device.
